title: A Shortage of Timber Begins with Too Few Trees

paragraphs.english: The UK is facing a future construction crisis because of a failure to plant trees to produce wood, Confor has warned. The forestry and wood trade body has called for urgent action to reduce the country’s reliance on timber imports and provide a stable supply of wood for future generations. Currently only 20 percent of the UK’s wood requirement is home-grown while it remains the second-largest net importer of timber in the world.
paragraphs.chinese: 英国林业及木材行业组织Confor警告说，由于没有种植足够的树木来生产木材，英国未来将面临建筑危机。该组织呼吁立即采取行动，降低英国对木材进口的依赖，并为子孙后代提供稳定的木材供应。目前，英国所需木材中只有20%产自本土，而它仍是全球第二大木材净进口国。

paragraphs.english: Coming at a time of fresh incentives from the UK government for landowners to grow more trees, the trade body says these don’t go far enough and fail to promote the benefits of planting them to boost timber supplies. “Not only are we facing a carbon crisis now, but we will also be facing a future construction crisis because of a failure to plant trees to produce wood,” said Stuart Goodall, chief executive of Confor. “For decades we have not taken responsibility for investing in our domestic wood supply, leaving us exposed to fluctuating prices and fighting for future supplies of wood as global demand rises and our own supplies fall.”
paragraphs.chinese: 英国政府刚推出新激励措施，鼓励土地所有者多植树。就在此时，该行业组织表示，这些措施力度不足，也没有充分宣传植树增加木材供应的好处。Confor首席执行官斯图尔特·古多尔说：“我们现在不仅面临碳排放危机，未来还会因为没有种植足够的用材树木而面临建筑危机。几十年来，我们没有承担起投资本国木材供应的责任，导致自己暴露于价格波动之下；随着全球需求上升、本国供应下降，我们还得争夺未来的木材供应。”

paragraphs.english: The UK has ideal conditions for growing wood to build low-carbon homes and is a global leader in certifying that its forests are sustainably managed, Confor says. While around three quarters of Scottish homes are built from Scottish timber, the use of home-grown wood in England is only around 25 percent. The causes of the UK’s current position are complex and range from outdated perceptions of productive forestry to the decimation of trees by grey squirrels. It also encompasses significant hesitation on behalf of farmers and other landowners to invest in long-term planting projects.
paragraphs.chinese: Confor表示，英国具备种植木材、建设低碳住宅的理想条件，而且在森林可持续经营认证方面居于全球领先地位。苏格兰约四分之三的住宅采用本地木材建造，而英格兰使用本土木材的比例仅约25%。英国形成当前局面的原因十分复杂，从对生产性林业的过时认识，到灰松鼠对树木的大量破坏，都包括在内。另外，农民和其他土地所有者对于投资长期植树项目，也存在明显的犹豫。

paragraphs.english: While productive tree planting can deliver real financial benefits to rural economies and contribute to the UK’s net-zero strategy, the focus of government support continues to be on food production and the rewilding and planting of native woodland solely for biodiversity. Goodall added: “While food production and biodiversity health are clearly of critical importance, we need our land to also provide secure supplies of wood for construction, manufacturing and contribute to net-zero.”
paragraphs.chinese: 尽管以生产木材为目的的植树能够为乡村经济带来切实的经济收益，并支持英国的净零排放战略，政府支持的重点仍然是粮食生产，以及纯粹为了生物多样性而开展的野化恢复和本土林地种植。古多尔补充道：“粮食生产和生物多样性健康显然至关重要，但我们也需要土地为建筑和制造业提供可靠的木材供应，并为净零排放作贡献。”

paragraphs.english: “While the UK government has stated its ambition for more tree planting, there has been little action on the ground. Confor is now calling for much greater impetus behind those aspirations to ensure we have enough wood to meet increasing demand.”
paragraphs.chinese: “英国政府虽然已经表明要扩大植树的雄心，实际行动却寥寥无几。Confor现在呼吁以更大力度推动这些目标落实，以确保我们有足够的木材满足不断增长的需求。”

sentenceNotes.sentence: “For decades we have not taken responsibility for investing in our domestic wood supply, leaving us exposed to fluctuating prices and fighting for future supplies of wood as global demand rises and our own supplies fall.”
sentenceNotes.mainClause: we have not taken responsibility for investing in our domestic wood supply.
sentenceNotes.structure: leaving现在分词短语说明结果，us后exposed和fighting并列说明处境；as引出需求上升和供应下降的背景。
sentenceNotes.translation: “几十年来，我们没有承担起投资本国木材供应的责任，导致自己暴露于价格波动之下；随着全球需求上升、本国供应下降，我们还得争夺未来的木材供应。”
sentenceNotes.tip: leaving不是另起一个主语，而是在解释长期投资不足带来的后果。

sentenceNotes.structure: While为让步“尽管”，不是时间含义；deliver和contribute并列；主句中food production与rewilding and planting并列，solely for biodiversity限定后一类支持目的。
